title: Magic Words
description: This is a Plugin that makes certain words in the chat do certain magic EFFECTS!
body:
MagicWords is a cinematic chat plugin that turns typed phrases into magical effects. Players speak, and the world responds — no commands, no menus, just pure spoken sorcery.
Perfect for roleplay servers, surprise events, or creative chaos, MagicWords lets you define custom incantations that trigger potion effects, particles, weather changes, entity spawns, and more. It’s lightweight, modular, and fully configurable via config.yml.
Whether you want to summon storms, teleport players, or unleash fireworks with a word, MagicWords makes chat feel enchanted. Drop it into your server, define your phrases, and let the magic unfold.
Compatible with Spigot and Paper (Minecraft 1.20+). MIT licensed. Designed for servers that crave immersion, spectacle, and surprise.
